svg.aria-label: How a plugin is reviewed and signed, in 7 steps. Your repo: 1. Your repo at a tag. This repo: 2. Our check. 3. We read the code. 4. Sealed build for 3 CPU types. 5. Sign and upload. Your HolyArrs: 6. HolyArrs checks the signature and fingerprint. 7. Every 6 hours it checks our blocklist and stops blocked versions.
svg.text: The tag points at the commit you name
Entry file checked against our rules
The code; websites match its list
From source, 3 CPU types, all hashed
Hashes again, then signs the list
A hash differs or an old list replays
